stories.summary: Did Michigan deserve that last second? We welcome college football back with all the absurdity it brings.

stories.title: U-M gets extra second, stuns WMU on Hail Mary
stories.summary: Michigan got a second chance at a Hail Mary and connected in a 13-12 stunner over Western Michigan on Saturday, after which the Big Ten confirmed officials correctly added time back on the clock to give the Wolverines another shot.

stories.title: Drama, delay doesn't dampen Kiffin's LSU debut
stories.summary: Arizona State transfer quarterback Sam Leavitt and Wisconsin transfer running back Dilin Jones combined for four rushing touchdowns in their new uniforms, and LSU ended a week of off-the-field drama with an easy 51-10 victory over Clemson on Saturday.

stories.title: Vikes' Smith agrees to deal, back for 15th season
stories.summary: Vikings safety Harrison Smith is returning for a 15th season, with sources telling NFL Network he reached a one-year deal worth $12.25 million.

stories.title: No. 2 Oregon gets 'wake-up call,' survives Boise
stories.summary: No. 2 Oregon overcame a slow start to down Boise State in the season opener Saturday, prompting Ducks coach Dan Lanning to call the performance a "wake-up call.''
